name: LinkedIn Lead Outreach
tagline: Turns comments on a lead post into logged, qualified LinkedIn contacts
description: Point it at the comments under a founder's giveaway or lead-magnet post. Each commenter is logged to Notion, answered in public, then moved into a direct message where the email handoff happens, and incoming connection requests get accepted. Volume stays inside the caps the card sets, so the pace is yours to choose.
author: ethan_leee9113
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
